ON THE 17 th OF JANUARY, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 48483 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 PRAN KOL S/O SHRI SANT KOL, AGED ABOUT 45 YEARS,
 OCCUPATION: LABOUR R/O CHEEP HOUSE DHANPURI  ALAMGANJ, POLICE AMLAI DISTRICT SHAHDOL  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY MS. GUNJAN NAIK - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION MAHILA THANA DISTRICT SHAHDOL  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY MS. PRITI SINGH - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.10/2023 dated 16.03.2023 registered at Police Station- Mahila Thana Shahdol, District-Shahdol, for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N) and 376(2)(F) of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 17.03.2023.
The applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
She also submits that the applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial as well as investigation and would make himself available as and when required.
Trial will take considerable time to conclude.
Upon these submissions, learned counsel prays that the applicant may be released on bail.
3. On the contrary, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: 4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.

5. This repeat bail application has been argued on the ground that despite repeated efforts on the part of the trial Court whereabouts the prosecutrix are not traceable and the applicant is languishing in jail on account of her non- availability for recording of evidence.
6. The earlier bail application was dismissed on merit by this Court under M.Cr.C.Nos.26880/2023 vide order dated 03.07.2023.
In that order, it is mentioned that the mother of prosecutrix present in the Court informed that the prosecutrix has gone away and on earlier occasions also, she had left the house.
The applicant is the father of the prosecutrix facing the charges of rape etc.

The order sheets of trial Court relied upon by the applicant reveal that on many hearings, prosecutrix was directed to be produce before the Court for evidence but police failed to comply with the order and even submitted the entry of Roznamchasana.
The Farari Panchnama was also prepared by the police regarding non-traceability of prosecutrix.

7. Having considered these facts and also the fact that the trial is being adjourned repeatedly for recording the statements of prosecutrix, this Court deems it fit to release the applicant on bail,
therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, this repeat application is allowed.
8.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of the trial.

9. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
10.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE NP Pran Kol vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66952669/
